title: Airport Master Plane Tycoon
description: Airport Master - Plane Tycoon is an airport management simulation game. With 3D stickman models, you can control the manager of a larger airport. Each level has a target passenger for you to complete. You can unlock the gate, scanner, security check, and lounge in the tutorials.

title: Block Puzzle: Slide Block Jam
description:
Slide the blocks, beat the clock, and master the puzzle jam!

Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam – Slide, Match, and Clear the Grid!

Get ready to train your brain in the most colorful way possible! In Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam, your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive—slide the colorful blocks to their matching exits and clear the board before time runs out.

title: DOP: Draw One Part
description:
► Can you see what’s missing? 

What a pretty picture, but don’t you get the nagging feeling that something’s not quite right? What’s the final touch that will make the image complete? 

Engage your brain, your imagination and your artistic talents to identify the missing element and add it to the drawing in this delightful puzzle game that will get you thinking and make you smile time and time again.

title: Color Screw Rescue Puzzle
description: Color Screw Rescue Puzzle challenges your brain with colorful screws, tricky layouts, and exciting rescue missions. Every level combines strategic thinking with satisfying screw-removal mechanics, creating a unique experience that fans of casual games and color sort games won't want to miss.

title: Woodland Slide
description:
Embark on a relaxing journey in Woodland Slide! Slide the colorful jewels across wooden planks to create perfect matches and clear the board.

With every move, a new row of gems disappears, adding to the challenge. Use your strategy and unlock powerful abilities to remove gems, split them into smaller pieces, or clear entire rows.

description: Beat off waves of snow monsters, connect cannons to get more and more improved cannon models. Monsters are strong and there are a lot of them, they constantly attack. Upgrade the base and guns, defeat them all!

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
description: Relive 2024’s hottest fashion trends in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition! From TikTok-inspired makeup to glamorous red carpet looks, this game brings together the best dress-up challenges of the year! Style iconic outfits, create bold beauty looks, and transform your favorite characters for every occasion—festivals, dates, holidays, and more! Are you ready to be the ultimate fashion trendsetter? Play now and own the style game!

title: Aha World Dream Town
description: Welcome to Aha World Dream Town, a casual life simulation game online. Whether you are an enthusiast of simulator games or just a casual player looking for relaxation online, do not miss this chance to experience a different world from your real life. Aha World Dream Town offers plenty of scenes, including supermarkets, restaurants, shops, and the game center. Traverse various charming settings and create new characters.

title: Witch & Fairy BFF
description: Two unusual girlfriends - a Fairy and a Witch - study together, although they are so different. Fairy, with her delicate pink outfits and impeccable sense of style, is always ready to offer fashion tips and create vivid images. Her girlfriend-Witch, who prefers a Gothic style, chooses mysterious and gloomy outfits. Players will be able to help both heroines choose outfits for various events. Join magical friends in their exciting fashion adventure where style and magic go hand in hand!

title: Angry Chibi Run
description: Angry Chibi RunAn endless sprinting running game. Jump and slide to avoid obstacles and dodge oncoming trains as fast as possible. Choose your favorite character, dress him up and surf the streets to your heart's content! What are you waiting for, come and join the best parkour game ever!

title: Hot & Cold Winter Style
description: Princesses Eliza and Milana are going on winter vacation, but for each of the girls, winter vacation will be special. Eliza lives in snowy regions and loves fluffy fur coats, warm scarves and winter dresses. Milana celebrates her holidays under palm trees and chooses swimsuits, light capes and bright accessories. Players will have to create stylish images, combining the cold shine of snow and the warm glow of the tropics. Help Eliza and Milana become the most fashionable princesses of winter!

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: Grow a Garden: Online & Offline
description:
"Grow a Garden: Online & Offline" – Become the best farmer!

Plant, grow, harvest, and earn millions while playing online with other players! Start with a simple plot and turn it into a huge farm with rare and magical plants. Buy seeds from the shop, which refreshes every 5 minutes. Find your plants on the market!

title: Mahjong Connect Cookware
description: Help your chef to clean his kitchen and remove all cookware by connecting them with a line that can change it's direction no more than 2 times!

title: Halloween Merge Mania
description: Halloween Merge Mania is a fast-paced casual game with a fun Halloween vibe. Cute monster balls—pumpkins, black cats, mummies, vampires, and other iconic characters—appear on the screen. Your task is to merge identical creatures to create new, rarer, and more valuable ones. Each successful merge unlocks the next level of spooky yet adorable monsters, while the dark background and vivid graphics immerse you in the festive autumn atmosphere.

title: Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot
description:
Explore a large sea world where fishing is the core of the adventure ??
Sail across the sea, travel between islands, and fish in many different locations. This online fishing game lets you catch fish, brainrots, and mysterious creatures while exploring a living ocean world filled with secrets ?️
Use your boat to move between islands and search for the best fishing spots ?

title: Uno Online
description:
UNO Online is a strategy card game. In the game, the first player to clear his hand will become the winner. In order to win, you need to guess the deck of cards in your opponent's hands and  arrange your card order reasonably. There are also function cards in the game. When you draw a function card, think about how to turn the situation to your advantage. You can use color cards to
change the color of the game, or use +2 cards to make your opponent's cards never run out.

title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
description: Designed for those who love ball games with realistic physics and elements, the goal of this game is to roll to the finish line without falling into the water. Master the control of the ball and collect coins on your route to unlock new balls, tail tracks and sky packages. You can play the game in 1 player mode or 2 player racing mode. Enjoy realistic nature, physics and effects in dozens of different levels!

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

• boosters for any situation — they keep you out of dead ends or pull you out of one

Score low, reshuffle when needed, and enjoy every move with playful golf lingo and island flair.

In this 2D puzzle-platformer, you can spin the entire world using magical leaves. Rotating the world changes gravity and helps you reach new paths.

Along the way, you'll need to push boxes, open doors, and avoid spikes and silly monsters.

description: It’s Thanksgiving, and the celebrities are getting ready for the big day! In Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep, you’ll help your favorite stars get glammed up for the holiday dinner. From cozy sweaters to chic party dresses, show off your fashion taste and creativity in this delightful seasonal makeover game.

With hundreds of challenging levels, you’ll dig through the Wild West to find hidden treasures and secrets. Ready to strike it rich? Join the Gold Rush adventure now!

description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. Clear colorful marbles, unlock powerful boosters, and prove you’re the master of marble puzzles! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers excitement like no other.

description: The Big Hit Run is a parkour game full of action! You will fly through colorful and vibrant cities. Avoid obstacles flexibly and keep running. Collect gems and power items. Watch your powers grow, with unbeatable arms.

description: Cargo Path Puzzle is a challenging 3D puzzle game that tests both logic and movement strategy. Navigate through complex levels filled with collapsing platforms, ice slides, trampolines, directional blocks, and deadly voids. Every level has only one correct path, so you'll need to think ahead and plan each move wisely. A single wrong step could trap you or block the way forward.

title: High Speed Crazy Bike
description: Get ready to take on the ultimate mud dirt bike racing challenge as you barrel through rough terrain at breakneck speeds, using your skills and quick reflexes to navigate through a myriad of obstacles and emerge victorious in this adrenaline-fueled test of skill and daring.

title: Island Battle 3D
description: Jump and survive in Island Battle 3D, a 3D IO game that will keep you on your toes. You will play as a jumper who must avoid falling off the island. You will also have to knock back your enemies and be the last one standing. You will face a strategic challenge, as the island’s surface is constantly breaking and changing. You can use this to your advantage and push your rivals into the gaps. But watch out, they can do the same to you.

title: Maze Escape Challenge
description: Maze Escape Challenge is a fast-paced maze game where you must reach the exit as quickly as possible. Each level features a unique labyrinth with increasing difficulty, traps, and surprises. Some levels include Dark Mode, where you can see only a small light around the player. Earn stars by finishing mazes fast (1–3 stars), unlock new levels, beat your best times, and try to master every maze.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Strawberry Shortcake has big dreams. She wants to be the BEST baker that Big Apple City  has ever seen and that's why she packed her bags and went to live with her Aunt Praline to the only place where a baker can go if they want to become the best in the whole world: the BIG APPLE CITY!

title: Order of Operation Challenge
description: Follow the order of operations to solve each expression. Use BODMAS / PEMDAS rules. Solve brackets (parentheses) first, then powers and square roots. Next, solve multiplication and division from left to right. Finally, solve addition and subtraction from left to right. Choose the correct answer from four options. Select a mode: Easy, Normal, Hard, or Pro. Solve 15 questions to advance to the next level. Harder modes give more XP.

title: Animation & Coloring Alphabet Lore
description: Learn and draw the Alphabet with Animation & Coloring Alphabet Lore, a fun and educational simulation game. You will discover the secrets of each letter before you bring it to life with your own colors and creativity. You can choose from sixteen letters and Free Draw mode to unleash your imagination. Explore magical locations, from the Moonlight Glade to the Slug Trail, and watch incredible creatures appear from small drops of magic potion. The game offers many levels, from simple to incredibly difficult, allowing each player to choose a suitable challenge.

Players play the role of cleaners in the health center in the game. They are responsible for the cleaning and sanitation work in all areas within the health center, keeping the environment of the health center clean and hygienic and providing a good environment for clients.
The game features a fresh and lovely art style, with the details of characters and buildings depicted vividly, bringing players a healing visual enjoyment.

Collect coins scattered throughout each level to buy yourself a new sword and enhance your gameplay experience. With each jump and sprint, you'll improve your skills and push your limits. Dive into the blocky world of Minecraft Obby, avoid obstacles, collect those coins, and most importantly—have fun!

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

On the mysterious and mist-shrouded island, you have the opportunity to strategically establish not one, but three main bases, bolstered by an additional rocket. Engage in an enthralling battle against a formidable opponent, both of you operating under identical circumstances. Your ultimate objective: obliterating all the enemy's main bases positioned on the neighboring fog-laden island. May victory in this war be your prized accomplishment!
