Unlock new portals with cubes!
Increase the starting level of cubes!
Extinguish burning cubes or instantly shatter the ice on all frozen cubes!

But be careful: if a stack overflows, the game ends!

title: Fruit Jam
description:
Make juice from fresh fruits in this easy and enjoyable Match-3 puzzle game!
Click on the fruit, if the fruit and the cup are the same color, just squeeze it.

title: Ninja Climb
description: Embark on a thrilling ascent in Ninja Climb, a captivating 2D game where your nimble ninja scales towering buildings. Click to seamlessly leap between structures, dodging obstacles along the way, and utilize rewarded video ads to revive when challenges arise, ensuring an adrenaline-packed ninja adventure.

title: Merge Flow
description: "Merge Flow"  is a casual puzzle game, by the board of 5*7 number squares and the bottom n +/- operators, each of the blocks have numbers, use the operator to make the number square +/-n, the same number will be combined into a +1 number, while obtaining the corresponding score. When the operators run out, the round ends.

title: Build an Aquapark
description:
? Welcome to the craziest water park! ?

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.

title: Plants Vs Zombies War
description: Plants Vs Zombies War is based on the famous PC game called Plants VS Zombies. This tower-defense strategy game needs your plans to fight against 15 kinds of incoming zombies. You can check the consumption and attack of all of your 15 plants before the battle. Then the tutorial will show the basic rules and plants at Level 1. The more levels you complete, the more plants you can unlock. You could also unlock them from ads in advance.

title: Mahjong Triple 3D Tile Match
description: Jump into a fresh and relaxing brain challenge with Mahjong Triple 3D - Tile Match, a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game that brings the classic mahjong experience into a colorful 3D world! In this game, the tiles are stacked in beautiful 3D shapes. Your goal is simple but satisfying: tap and collect three identical tiles to clear them from the board.

title: 67 Clicker Tap Tap
description: 67 Clicker is a fast, funny, and highly addictive meme clicker game where every tap brings you closer to unlocking a strange and unforgettable collection of 67-themed characters. Your goal is simple at first: click or tap to earn 67 Points, spend them on upgrades, and keep growing your power. The ultimate objective is to reach the final upgrade, The 67 Galaxy, and unlock all 14 unique 67 characters waiting across the journey.

title: CrazySteve.io
description: CrazySteve.io is an awesome multiplayer game based on the iconic Steve from Minecraft. In this game, Steve is holding a blasting competition and each player must work hard to try and be crowned king of the competition.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Sudoku Master
description: Sudoku by in8finity is a classic puzzle game with a sleek dark theme, offering a smooth and enjoyable experience. Flexible settings let you adjust the difficulty to match your skill level. With intuitive controls and eye-friendly visuals, you can focus on solving puzzles without distractions. More than just a game, Sudoku trains logic, concentration, and memory. Challenge yourself and enjoy relaxing, distraction-free gameplay!

title: Farm vs Zombies
description: The undead are hungry, but this farmer isn't backing down! Plant mutant defenses, harvest resources in real-time, and protect your homestead in this addictive strategy survival game.

title: Single Line: Drawing Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind and unleash your creativity with Single Line: Drawing Puzzle! This exciting game is perfect for anyone who loves brain teasers and enjoys solving clever puzzles. Your mission is simple yet addictive: draw one continuous line to complete intricate designs without lifting your finger or retracing your steps. Are you ready to take on this one-line challenge? ?

title: The Lost City - Match 3
description:
Hit three in a row and get a crazy field explosion!
Use colorful booster effects that will make the game even more fun and colorful!
No stressful time restrictions! Enjoy the adventure freely!
Go through a wide selection of mysterious and mystical stages.
Complete various levels and get happiness from breaking gems!

title: Monster School Challenge
description: Complete teacher's assignments for evaluation, finding out who is a Noob and who is a Pro! Different tests and characters are waiting for you in the game Monster School Challenge.

title: Dragon Island Idle 3d
description: Welcome to Dragon Island Idle 3D, a casual idle 3D world. Raise your dragons and build a wonderful island empire. Unlock all facilities to get income. For example, unlock a new pasture to raise more dinos. Unlock synths for the new area. Unlock the incubator to get dinos.

title: HexaMatch
description:
HexaMatch – The Ultimate Number Puzzle!
Swipe and sort tiles into the empty slot to solve addictive hexa puzzles. With progressive difficulty, unique gameplay, and a fresh twist on classic number games, HexaMatch is perfect for all ages. Train your brain, relax your mind, and enjoy endless fun with this simple yet challenging merge hexa puzzle!

title: Pirates Match The Lost Treasure
description: Enjoy this pirates adventure and find the lost treasure . Immerse yourself in an exciting match 3 game with many levels and excellent graphics. Solve all the match 3 puzzles and escape find the pirates lost treasure using your skills, and amazing power-ups to complete the levels.

title: Bus Jam
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of "Bus Jam: Clear the Bus Stop," presented by Golden Guns Studio, a color sort puzzle, fun-packed game where your task is to skillfully bus match 3d passengers onboard onto buses of the same color. Imagine a busy Bus Jam stop with vibrant buses and puzzled passengers eager to board. Your mission? Ensure each person finds their way to the right bus, and brace yourself as the color puzzle master.

title: Snow Rush 3D
description:
Snow Rush 3D is a fun sledding game that tests speed and reflexes for winter sports enthusiasts, playable in both 1 and 2 players! Try to reach the longest distance by overcoming obstacles and ramps on a challenging snow-covered track, or challenge your friend!

Snowmen, obstacles and tricky turns await you along the way. How far can you go and how many gifts can you collect?

title: Bbq Stack Run
description: Enter a running arcade adventure filled with food and fun challenges. BBQ Stack Run takes you through the craziest BBQ-collecting parkour ever. Pick up various ingredients such as beef, chicken, sausage and more on the track as you run. Sprinkle them with barbecue seasoning and cook them through.

title: Code Maze
description: Master programming logic with Code Maze! Use code blocks to navigate mazes, overcome obstacles, and reach goals. Each level challenges your problem-solving skills. Ready to code your way out?

title: Formula Racers
description: Formula Racers is the ultimate HTML5 browser top-down arcade racing game - no download required! Race on any device across 10 thrilling tracks, tackle dynamic lap tracking and real-time placement, and earn coins to unlock and upgrade cars (engine, gearbox, steering, brakes). This online racing game features HD graphics, responsive design, immersive SFX & music - perfect for mobile & desktop gamers seeking fast-paced, addictive arcade action!

title: Parking Fury 3D: Night City
description:
Welcome to the adrenaline-filled world of Parking Fury 3D, where you'll be at the wheel of various vehicles navigating the bustling streets of a massive city.

Whether you're behind the wheel of a taxi or driving an ambulance through traffic to save lives, each mission presents its own challenges and rewards.

For those who dare, there is the exciting world of car theft missions. Take on the role of a skilled driver tasked with procuring specific vehicles under the cover of darkness.

title: Drive, Race, Crash
description: Drive, Race, Crash is a game that will give you hours of fun and adrenaline.  Drive a variety of cars, choose your own style of play and go to conquer the tracks in races, participate in derbies, jump off the ramp or explore the city

title: Cat From Hell Cat Simulator
description: Become the troublemaking cat in Cat From Hell - Cat Simulator. Run wild inside Granny’s house, knocking things over and making a mess, such as breaking plates, throwing balls, smashing fish tanks, etc. Escape before she catches you. Explore, prank, and cause chaos in this hilarious and mischievous cat simulator. Every corner hides a secret that can be destroyed, and discover new challenges.

title: Block Mine Fuse TNT
description: Free the world from Herobrine and its creepy buildings. Upgrade and drop TNT, rockets and all your power on cubic settlements.

title: Peckshot
description: Stop the arrow at the right time and keep hitting the target. If you miss the target, the game ends. You can earn coins depending on the game results, and you can use the coins to get skins.

title: Word Search Universe
description: Word Search Universe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you search for hidden words in a grid. The game has 20 chapters, and each one comes with easy, medium, and hard levels to match your skill. In every level, you need to find 6 hidden words. If you get stuck, you can use a hint to help you out. It's a great way to have fun, improve your vocabulary, and keep your brain sharp!

title: Jab Jab Boxing
description: Step into the electrifying world of competitive boxing in Jab Jab Boxing, where you'll type motivational words to unleash powerful jabs and combos, all set within a dynamic boxing ring stadium vibe. Immerse yourself in fluid character animations, draw inspiration from over 200 motivational quotes and phrases, and sharpen your typing speed as you train to become the ultimate boxing champion.

title: C.A.P.
description:
Take to the skies and protect the carrier in this shooter inspired by WW2 dogfights. 
Dodge enemy fighters, protect your aircraft carrier, and blast through waves of incoming planes. 
Remember to come back to the carrier to refuel!
With crisp pixel-art 3D visuals and one-touch controls, this shooter delivers satisfying action perfect for short play.

title: Burger Day
description: Burger Day is a fun and fast-paced arcade game that puts you in charge of a busy burger kitchen. Stack ingredients to serve up tasty orders as quickly as possible. Your speed and decision-making skills are tested as customer demands increase. Satisfy hungry customers to unlock fresh challenges and advance through exciting levels.

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: Cleaning Simulator
description:
Cleaning Simulator is a very fun simulation game. Although this game is 2D, it restores the shape of objects in real life very well. This game has a total of 12 parts, covering sports cars, technological products, daily necessities, and other elements, which will definitely meet all your
expectations for cleaning games. Want to know more about this game? Come and try it!

title: Stick Rope Hero
description: Are you ready to become a super stickman hero? In Stick Rope Hero, you enter an exciting sandbox world filled with adventures and challenges. Swing around the open city with your powerful rope skills and completing many action tasks.

title: Geometry Platformer
description: Geometry Platformer is a fast-paced, reflex-testing platformer where players guide a shape-shifting cube through a series of dangerous geometric obstacles. The game features sharp spikes, swinging hazards, and gravity-defying mechanics that challenge your timing and precision. The neon graphics and intense gameplay create a thrilling experience, requiring quick reactions and memorization of complex patterns.

title: Fire snake
description: Help the fire snake slither safely home! Dodge dangerous obstacles, collect shiny coins, and master tricky levels. Can you guide the snake through every challenge? Play now and test your skills!

title: Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games
description: Get ready to navigate through the fast-paced world of healthcare, where every second counts. Your mission as a hyper nurse is to provide exceptional care to patients, manage critical situations, and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital. Get ready to put your multitasking skills to the test as you juggle multiple tasks and make crucial decisions in hyper nurse: hospital games.

title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
description: Test your makeup artist skills in Dazzling Divas Makeup! Inspired by My Little Pony, this colorful dress-up game lets you create magical makeup looks for three fabulous girls—Lila, Mimi, and Roxy. Style each diva with Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, and Rainbow Dash–inspired makeup, then complete their look with trendy tops and accessories. With endless outfit combos and sparkling vibes, this is the ultimate glam experience for fashion lovers!

title: Steampunk Merge To Battle
description: Merge to Battle is a strategy game where the goal is to capture all the castles in your way. Unite your warriors and archers on the battlefield and fight against enemies. Build and upgrade your castle and troops. Explore the entire evolution of warriors by combining two units into an even stronger one. React quickly and use strategy and tactics to win the battle and advance to the next level.

title: Oil Tanker Transport Truck
description: Let's go on to ride with an oil tanker transporter truck across all the continents like the Euro, Asia, and America oil transporter truck game has real features in the Euro and American cargo systems of the fuel truck.

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Solitaire Daily
description: Your favorite dose of daily solitaire is here! Come back everyday to sit back, relax and play a game of cards! Do you have what it takes to become an absolute Solitaire master? Try it now.

title: Geometrix
description: Geometrix is a game about guessing the right shape. Defeat the enemies copying their shapes. When you collide with the evil shapes, if you have the same geometrical figure, you will destroy the enemy, otherwise you will lost a health point. Lost more than three points and it will be game over. Face over 40 levels, with increasing difficulty, enemies with up to 6 different geometric figures. You have to be fast and skilled to beat this game. Will you make it? If you want to know it, just try it!

title: Liquids Sort Puzzle
description:
Colorful, bubbling, fragrant, and iridescent concoctions fill flasks, jugs, and test tubes in varying proportions!

Figure out strategy and create harmony by collecting liquids of different colors and properties in different containers!

Test your attention and reasoning skills in this meditative puzzle game. 

Many levels of increasing difficulty and bonus tasks await you! 

Excellent attention training and good mood guaranteed!

title: Cuddle Monster Fusion
description: Engage, Merge, and Challenge! Dive into a world of cuddly creatures where you combine identical monsters to evolve them and keep them from overflowing. But here’s the twist: when the same monsters collide, they transform into an entirely new, adorable creature. Can you merge your way to the ultimate fluffy beast?

title: Jewel Monsters
description: Jewel Monsters is a match-3 game to attack the monster by matching identical gems of the same color as fast as possible. Release Date December 2021 Developer Jewel Monsters was made by IriySoft.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Lost in the Forest
description:
Lost in the forest is a classic adventure game. The protagonist is an airman who ends up in a storm, loses control of his plane and falls into a mysterious forest.
The next day is stuck under a tree and must find a way to break free and solve various puzzles to make it back home safely.

title: Astro Kitty Rush
description: Help Astro Kitty rush through space! Dodge deadly asteroids, collect coins, and beat your high score! Grab power-ups, complete missions, and see how long you can survive in the galaxy. Perfect for casual players of all ages!

title: Offroad Island
description: "Offroad Island" is an exciting racing game where you compete with different vehicles, earn money by completing missions, and customize your vehicles by upgrading them. Each map offers an adventure full of challenges. Are you ready for a journey full of speed and excitement?

title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
description:
Enjoy a relaxing round of Golf Solitaire, a fun and easy-to-play card game. The goal is to clear the board by matching cards that are one rank higher or lower than the one on the discard pile. Don’t worry about suits—just focus on the numbers! If you’re stuck, you can draw from the deck to keep the game going. Play at your own pace and see how many rounds you can win.

Perfect for a quick break or to unwind at the end of the day!

title: Happy Monsters 2
description:
A bundle of fun games designed for children of all ages that will delight everyone!

Our little monsters love to play all sorts of games where you collect coins. Help them gather as many as possible to unlock all the toys. Complete the entire toy collection!

title: Geometry Arrow
description: Dive into an exhilarating journey through a treacherous cave! Your mission: reach the portal at the end of each level while avoiding deadly spikes and obstacles. With six progressively harder levels, you’ll need sharp reflexes and spot-on timing to survive. Can you conquer every challenge and make it out of the cave? Put your skills to the test in this high-speed action game!

title: Spider Rope Hero City Fight
description: Protect the crime city by your extreme super powers. You will be a rope hero with ability of flying, crawling and spider. Now you have to eliminate the mafia. Your duty starts with the ultimate security of the president. The gangsters have kidnapped the state president, chased the gangsters and saved your president. Swing into action and unleash your superhero powers to save the city from chaos and destruction.

title: PIZZA PUZZLE
description: Match the same pieces to complete the whole. If you are next to the same piece, the pieces will come together. Game over when there is no place to put pizza.

title: Solitaires Crime Stories
description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unraveling the   mysteries of the town of Springdale!
    Springdale is a small American town that lives in peace and quiet... but that’s only at first glance. Everyone hides secrets here, secrets that could tear this carefree town apart.

title: Super Pop Blast
description: Get ready for a new kind of brick shooter, with unique mechanics, rewarding challenges, and colorful levels. The object: Clear all the blocks using a limited number of balls. Plan your moves, use the score combo system, and try to get 3 stars!

title: Cake Sort
description:
Cake Sort is a colorful and cozy puzzle game where you stack and sort delicious desserts to score as many points as possible! Move cakes around the table and match them by type to build perfect stacks of identical treats.
Bright graphics, smooth animations, and tasty visuals make the game relaxing, cheerful, and endlessly replayable.
Your goal is simple — keep sorting cakes and earn points for every perfect match until the table is full!

title: Christmas Blocks Sort
description: Blocks Sort Christmas Edition brings a cozy holiday twist to the classic sorting puzzle. All the blocks have turned into festive Christmas colors like bright red, pine green, frosty blue, and warm gold. They start mixed together in different columns, and your job is to sort them so each column ends up with just one color. The rules are simple, but the challenge is still satisfying. Think ahead, plan your moves, and slowly bring order to the holiday chaos.

title: Brainrot Mob Clash 3D
description: Welcome to the wild and chaotic world of Brainrot Mob Clash 3D. It’s a full-blown racing and fighting adventure. Dash through 3D obstacle courses, avoid deadly traps like spikes and spinning saws. Match and merge your stickman army. Crush enemy mobs in exciting action-packed battles. As you run, collect brainrot characters to increase your numbers and merge them to form powerful units.

title: Tangle Master 3D
description: Play Tangle Master 3D free online and dive into a satisfying browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Untangle twisted ropes and solve each knot in a clever logic puzzle that doubles as a relaxing brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for calm focus and smart fun anytime.

title: Duck Luck
description:
Guide a lovable duck and his humorous friend and drop numbered blocks that merge when identical numbers come into contact, creating larger numbers that help clear the board. 
As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.

title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
description: X to Y is a fast-paced precision platform skill game focused on timing, reflexes, and speed control. Guide X through dangerous obstacles, traps, and tight spaces to reach Y. Every move requires perfect acceleration and sharp reactions — one mistake and you fail. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new worlds, including dark mode challenges, auto-movement stages, and physics-based puzzles.

title: Ibiza Foam Party
description: Splash around in a sea of bubbles, dance to pumping beats, and compete against friends in wild and energetic beauty challenges. Ready to get the fun started? Then join Gina and Selena in this colorful, summer-themed makeover game for girls, and help them deal with their dazzling party looks. From scrubbing and skincare to makeup and fabulous fashion, you’re the ultimate stylist, ensuring these besties shine bright under the Ibiza sun.

title: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
description:
Welcome to the mysterious world of Ancient Egypt! Find matching tiles, solve mahjong levels and collect artifacts to uncover secrets of Giza valley, Old city, Desert and Nile.
Discover how the Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed, how Egyptians learned to read hieroglyphs, why only the pharaoh could own a cat in Ancient Egypt and many more. 
Simple and engaging gameplay of mahjong solitaire is the best way to relax. You will find huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more.

title: Save Seafood
description: Save Seafood is an exciting puzzle game where you help sea animals escape from being trapped in a tangled mess! The goal is to move and rearrange the animals to free them from the crowd. Solve each puzzle by carefully maneuvering the creatures until they’re all safely separated. Can you untangle the sea and set the animals free?

title: My Fire Station World
description: Have you ever wondered how the firefighter rescues and helps others in emergencies? How do they deal with dangerous fires? This role-play takes you to explore the world of firefighters and learn about their daily work. Our game has 6 scenarios about the life and work of firefighters for you to choose from. You can drag and drop to place the characters as you like, place props, and change the firefighting costumes.

title: House of Celestina
description: House of Celestina is a 3D survival horror game that can keep you on the edge of your seat, but only for so long, as the game's objective is to find the key to escape. The game is designed to explore the House of Celestina, where you'll find clues and keys to help you figure out where you are and how to get out.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Kuzbass Horror
description: Kuzbass is a horror game where you try to cope with a mad witch and uncover the terrible secret of an abandoned village. This horror flick with an interesting plot will make you afraid to get out of bed at night.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: CarJamcolor
description:
There was a long queue of passengers at the public station platform with a "car jam" in the parking lot! what to do?

Now it's time for the cars to transport passengers, you need to move them...but wait! You need to do it in the right order. Because other cars in the parking lot that become an obstacle! Can you solve this tricky parking puzzle and get all the cars on the road?
what are you waiting for? Challenge your brain with this tricky game now!

title: Pinball Basketball
description: A captivating fusion of classic arcade pinball excitement and thrilling sports gameplay. Flip your paddle skillfully to keep the ball in play, aiming for the basketball hoop while enjoying the stunning minimalist art and responsive design that make every moment electrifying and addictive.

title: Chill Clicker
description: Chill Clicker is a clicker game where you multiply the Chill Capybara population by clicking. You can buy various upgrades to increase the output of Chill Capybaras, change the weather, and unlock new skins to make you the coolest Chill Capybara in town.

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Stack Tower Pro
description: Test your precision in this addictive 3D block stacking game! Build the tallest skyscraper, unlock stunning themes, and master the art of balance. Can you reach the stars?

title: Stick - Color War
description:
To defeat enemies you must shoot bullets of the same color as the enemy. 
Every five levels you have to defeat a boss.
Breaking off new weapons.
Will you be able to resist the colored sticks?
Play our shooter without downloads and registration.

title: Mystical Blade 3D
description: Enter the world of Mystical Blades, where you design and battle your own B-Blades! Mix blades, rings, and elements to create powerful combos, then face players worldwide in thrilling battles. With stunning graphics and realistic physics, prove your skills and become the ultimate B-Blades master!

title: Zombie Drift 3D
description: Zombie Drift 3D is a popular driving game. It doesn't require you to race or race against others, but it also tests your driving skills. You need to control the car to hit everything to make the exit open. Only in this way, you can get the success! Come on!

title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
description: Moto Attack - Bike Racing is a fun bike racing simulator that takes speed and action to the next level. Drive your motorcycle and race against opponents. You can use weapons to attack them. Ride your bike through challenging tracks, and avoid obstacles like people crossing the street, cabs, boxes, etc.

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Crash Car Parkour Simulator
description:
Test the cars in a real crash test!

You need to get to the finish line, but on the way you will meet many obstacles. Car presses, huge hammers and much more will try to crush you and turn your car into trash. Show real car driving skills.

title: GTA: Grand Vegas Crime
description: Grand Vegas Crime is an open-world action game set in a sprawling city inspired by Las Vegas. Players take on the role of a daring gangster looking to rise through the criminal underworld. The game offers intense missions, thrilling car chases, and fierce shootouts against rival gangs and law enforcement. Grand Vegas Crime delivers an adrenaline-pumping experience filled with crime, action, and adventure.

title: 2 Player Games Design Salon
description: The Creative Showdown is officially underway! In the 2 Player Games Design Salon, you’ll compete in a real-time design contest against another player, with aesthetics and creativity determining the winner. Every round introduces a new artistic task packed with fun surprises. Built around expressive design gameplay, the experience stays relaxing yet competitive, making it a perfect casual multiplayer challenge.

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Save the Daddy
description:
Get ready to unlock a world of tricky puzzles and brain teasers in Save the Daddy. Each level is unique and carefully designed to challenge your mind and test your IQ. Pull the pin in the right order and help the man escape from dangerous monsters & obstacles safely and thoughtfully.
Play each level very cautiously by analyzing your move before pulling the pin. As you progress, levels increase in difficulty which will make you game challenging and earn more rewards.

title: Crunch Locked
description: Crunch Locked is a satisfying puzzle game where every move brings the pieces closer together. Tap available segments to snap them into place and gradually build complete shapes. As the structure collapses into a single remaining piece, the final segment crunches away and clears the level. With locked parts, blocked paths, and increasingly clever layouts, every puzzle requires careful planning and the right sequence of moves.

title: Obby With Friends: Draw and Jump
description: Obby With Friends: Draw and Jump is a multiplayer casual art drawing game where players team up in an exciting parkour platformer. Solve puzzles, create platforms, and navigate traps with your friends to conquer various challenges.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Plug Man Race
description: Plug Head Race plays like a collecting arcade game with battery items. To win the level, you need to overpass the finish line in first place. Each platform requires a lot of red battery items, collect them, and use them to pass the current switch. When you are weaker than others, keep away from them and collect red battery items only.  Remember to buy your favorite skins when you have enough gold coins.

title: Wheel of Bingo
description:
Wheel of Bingo has two parts. Part 1: Spin the wheel to match bingo numbers. To help the player, colored marks are drawn on the wheel to indicate their bingo numbers. For every match, the player gains points and a colored ball to be used in part 2. For a complete bingo line, many extra balls are awarded.

Part 2: Drop balls to match colors in plinko. The point values shown at the bottom of the screen are base values, but are multiplied if there is a successful color match (GREEN MATCH X 5).

title: Swat Force Vs Terrorists
description: Swat Force Vs Terrorists is an intense tactical shooter where players take on the role of elite SWAT team members engaging in high-stakes confrontations with terrorists. The game emphasizes teamwork and tactical coordination, requiring players to utilize professional counter-terrorism skills and equipment across various complex urban environments.

title: Make America Great Again
description: Take control of a powerful character in the center of the ring, facing waves of wrestlers charging from the right. Your reflexes will be tested as you press directional buttons to deliver well-timed punches and knock out the incoming opponents. As you progress, you'll unlock special abilities that temporarily increase the strength of your punches, allowing you to knock out multiple enemies in a line with a single powerful blow.

title: Wild Race Master 3d
description: Wild Race Master 3D is an exciting 3D racing game that brings you into a world of extreme speed!In this game, you can experience endless racing fun and drive various cool cars. Challenge the exciting track! ? Drive your beloved racing car through various unique and challenging tracks. You should show excellent driving skills on winding roads and be flexible when dealing with various complex track conditions.

title: On Fire Basketball Shots
description: The gym is packed, and the crowd is roaring! The scoreboard's ticking down, and your team is trailing. The only way to win is to sink blazing basketball shots from the court. You're the star player, but the pressure's on—every shot counts, and the hoop's rim is red-hot, making each attempt trickier!

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: Superwings Subway
description:
Explore with ASTRA:
Cross the space dodging all kinds of obstacles with Astra. Move along three rails dodging, jumping or passing under all kinds of traps and avoid meteorites.
Be careful, the rails are incomplete and you can fall into the void.

title: Snake 2048
description: Start as a small cube in this thrilling online game! Eat smaller snakes, dodge stronger ones, and grow into a giant. Enjoy endless challenges, competitive leaderboards, and exciting gameplay. Play now and dominate the arena!

title: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure
description: Dive into a hilarious and action-packed adventure. Sausage Man Shooting Adventure is a fast-paced side-scrolling shooting game where you control a crazy, energetic sausage hero and blast through waves of enemies. Run forward, dodge traps, jump platforms, and shoot enemies with nonstop excitement! Collect airdrops to increase your damage.

title: Monster Dash
description:
Sprint, Jump and Blast your way through Monster Dash, an action-packed game by the creators of Jetpack Joyride and Fruit Ninja.

Join Barry Steakfries and his iconic Machine Gun Jetpack in a world full of menacing monster mayhem, as you run and gun your way through hordes of zombies, vampires and more with the most explosive and powerful weapons you can find!

title: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting
description: Ready to become the coldest, deadliest sniper in the entire city? Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting is a FPS action shooting simulator where you complete high-risk missions. Use powerful guns to eliminate dangerous mafia targets.

title: Block Merge City
description: Block Merge City is a relaxing isometric puzzle game where you place and combine buildings to evolve them into bigger structures. Strategically plan your moves, score high, and avoid running out of space!

title: Christmas sorting
description:
Christmas Sorting is a relaxing game for all ages. Place objects next to each other to collect 3 identical objects in a row.
Collect all the unique decorations for a Christmas atmosphere.
Create Christmas coziness, decorate the Christmas tree the way you want.

title: Autumn Glam Gala
description: Get ready for the ultimate fall beauty adventure at the Autumn Glam Gala! Help three BFFs create stunning makeup looks for the most anticipated gala of the season. From soft, natural tones to bold, sparkling colors, you’ll have endless fun choosing makeup, hairstyles, and glamorous outfits. Experiment with fall-inspired looks and fashion trends to ensure each girl shines at the gala. Are you ready to showcase your makeup artist skills? Play Autumn Glam Gala now and let the glam begin!

title: Skating Park
description: Welcome to Skating Park, where skateboards meet high-speed racing madness! Dive into a world of adrenaline-fueled stunts and fierce competition as you shred through gravity-defying tracks. Master insane ramps, outmaneuver opponents, and conquer the leaderboard. Feel the thrill as you jump off the track, taking daring shortcuts to gain the edge. Get ready to grind and glide your way to victory!

title: HexaFill
description: This is a relaxing hex-grid puzzle game where you connect paths, fill cells, and solve unique levels without overlaps or dead ends

title: Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in madness and fun as a mischievous cat who decided to turn grandma's cozy house into a field of chaos! ? Break pots, steal fish from the aquarium, throw things and scratch everything that comes under your paw. And all this is in the form of a first-person simulator with elements of humor and mayhem.

title: Merge Hotel Empire
description: You can generate and collect different new items by synthesizing the same items, and then use them to create and decorate a new mansion for the hotel empire of the story.

title: Cooking Restaurant Kitchen
description: Prepare and cook delicious food from all over the world in Cooking Restaurant Kitchen. Build the cafe of your dreams while serving hot and awesome meals to hungry customers at a fast pace! Don't let the time run out, practice your time management skills, and get ready to experience the craze of real cooking!

title: Hidden Objects: Vacation in Brazil
description:
Discover Hidden Treasures in Brazil – Play "Hidden Objects: Vacation in Brazil"!

Embark on a thrilling hidden object adventure through Brazil! Search and find hidden objects in stunning locations, enjoy fun mini-games, and collect unique souvenirs.

Explore famous landmarks like SugarLoaf Mountain and the Amazon jungle. Visit ancient castles, vibrant museums, and mysterious caves. Experience the energy of Rio de Janeiro and unwind on Brazil’s beautiful beaches.

title: Plants Warfare
description: Plants Warfare is a shooting game where you step into the shoes of the cute plants. Aim your projectiles, and take down the zombies with strategic aiming and precision shots. Use the environment to your advantage—ricochet bullets and eliminate multiple targets with the least shots possible! Collect stars, customize your look, and prove you’re the ultimate plant defense.

title: Bears vs. Art
description:
Bears vs. Art is the premium version of the slash em’ up puzzle game you love! Exclusive to this version of Bears vs. Art - enjoy uninterrupted, thought-provoking puzzles.
Each painting is protected by sneaky security measures including lasers, spikes and mind-bending portals. Not to mention snooty guests, nosy security guards and art-snatching thieves!

title: Smart Dots Reloaded
description: Smart Dots Reloaded is a fresh remake of the classic Dots and Boxes puzzle from Windows 3.1. Players take turns drawing lines between dots. Completing a square earns a point, and the game ends when the board is full. Featuring modern visuals, smooth animations, and both AI and two-player modes, this is a strategy game that’s easy to learn but hard to master.

title: Merge 2048 Cake
description:
Merge 2048 Cake is a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where you merge matching tiles to create higher numbers!
Combine three or more identical tiles to form a new one with double the value. Plan your moves, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and aim for the ultimate 2048 tile!
Enjoy smooth gameplay, vivid visuals, and a cozy, casual vibe that’s easy to play and hard to put down.

title: Connect Clues - The Missing Professor
description:
A tangled detective story is about to unfold.

Inspector Hale and Detective Crane are on the trail of a mysteriously vanished professor of history and archaeology — who also happens to be Crane’s old friend.
Professor Eldridge was always a touch eccentric, but disappearing without a word and leaving his office turned upside down was never part of his habits. He’s clearly in trouble — and in need of help.

title: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle
description: Single Stroke: Energy Line Puzzle is a fun and simple way to train your brain every day. This mind-challenging game has easy rules—just connect all the circles using a single continuous line. It’s a great way to keep your brain sharp with quick, clever puzzles. Spend just a few minutes daily to give your mind a boost. Enjoy this brain-training experience anytime, anywhere!

title: Atomic Merge 2048
description:
Atomic Merge 2048 is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop and combine numbered blocks to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Strategically  drop blocks which fall on to center , merge identical numbers, and keep the pile from touching the red orbit. Watch out — one wrong drop could be the end!
Perfect for fans of casual, merge, and puzzle games. How high can you score before the stack overflows?

title: Mahjong Connect Majong Class
description: Mahjong Connect is a classic elimination-style casual game where players need to find and connect identical mahjong tiles on the board. The game rules are simple yet challenging, suitable for players of all ages.

title: Super Tank Hero
description: Super Tank Hero is an action shooting game. You can drive a tank to shoot and fight on the battlefield, usually facing seven enemies and obstacles. You need to collect soldiers before the battle, they'll join your team and help you fight. You can also find energy and Life on the battlefield to increase your speed or power. When you are able to fight, follow the instructions to find your opponent and fire at him until you beat him.

title: Ball Paint 3D
description: Ball Paint 3D is a relaxing, simple, and fun game for kids, free online. You only have to find the balls of the same color within the limited number of balls given to you to pass the game, with beautiful 3D graphics to give you the best gaming experience. It's a battle of the brains, do you dare to challenge?

title: Freecell Solitaire
description:
Put your mind to the test with FreeCell, one of the most beloved solitaire card games of all time!

Move cards between columns, use the free cells cleverly, and organize suits in ascending order to win.

Elegant graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls make every game a relaxing and satisfying experience.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or a curious beginner, FreeCell will win you over with its perfect mix of simplicity and strategy.

title: Hit ball
description:
Hit ball is a fast-paced arcade game with roguelike elements, in which you fight off waves of enemies with ricocheting balls! With each shot you break through obstacles, knock down monsters and earn experience to improve your abilities.
Dozens of levels with unique traps, walls, boosting balls and dangerous bosses await you. Collect boosters, pick up abilities, regenerate health and strategize to survive the battle!

title: Zombie Road: Shooter with Destruction
description: Grandpa is eager for adventure again! Survive in a harsh zombie world. This time, Grandpa has to save the world from evil zombies. Zombies can drive and shoot! And Grandpa can destroy evil spirits! Fight the most dangerous mutants. Buy cool guns, find unique attachments, assemble your own unique gun and go into battle! Many locations, go through the whole world, from hot deserts to sea battles!

title: Crystal Connect
description: Discover the enchanting world of Crystal Connect, a captivating game with breathtaking graphics! Join a pair of dwarves on an epic quest to collect precious crystals and navigate through dozens of challenging levels in this immersive connect-style adventure game. Connect pairs of gems, create powerful combinations and pave your way to victory. Dive into the adventure today and discover the magic of Crystal Connect

title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
description:
Embark on an armored adventure in Tanks Merge: Tanks to Attack on the Blitz! -
a strategy game where steel giants dominate the world.
Immerse yourself in a casual yet addictive tank simulation game
designed for those who love war machines and inventive tactics.
Have a blitz rumble and defeat all the bosses!
Your mission: control a fleet of tanks, each unique in design and
to defeat enemies and all bosses on the battlefield.

title: The Best Warrior
description: In The Best Warrior, you start as a humble peasant with one goal—to become the greatest warrior in the kingdom. Train by clicking on dummies to build attack power, defeat enemies for gold, and unlock powerful skins to grow even faster. Face epic bosses, collect timed chest rewards, and rise through multiple levels. With nonstop action, upgrades, and progression, this free adventure clicker game lets you prove your strength with every tap. Start your journey now and become a legend!

title: Hobo Speedster
description: Hobo Speedster is an exciting motorcycle platform BMX game featuring 2D cartoon graphics. Your mission? Keep the motorcycle balanced until you reach the finish line. As you earn coins and diamonds, upgrade your current bike at the motorcycle settlement, purchase 3 more motorcycles from the Shop, and unlock 4 additional riders in the Decorate section. Ready for a personal challenge? Explore various maps and aim to complete all 7 tasks for extra rewards!

title: Pongoal
description: PONGOAL is an exciting fusion of classic Pong and high-stakes football action! Experience the timeless paddle gameplay you love, reimagined with the energy and intensity of a penalty shootout. Defend your goal, outsmart your opponent, and score spectacular goals in this fast-paced arcade sports challenge.

title: Ibiza Foam Party
description: Ibiza Foam Party is a vibrant summer-themed makeover game where you join Gina and Selena for an electrifying experience in the party capital of the world. As their stylist, you’ll scrub, pamper, and perfect their look with dazzling makeup and fashion, ensuring these best friends dazzle under the Ibiza sun.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Block TNT Blast
description: Block TNT Blast is an exciting sandbox simulation game that will ignite your imagination and strategic skills. In this game, players are tasked with strategically placing bombs to demolish various objects and earn diamonds. These diamonds are then used to unlock a wide range of powerful bombs, adding to the explosive mayhem. With its captivating gameplay and stunning graphics, Block TNT Blast offers endless hours of entertainment for players of all ages.

title: Penguin Adventure
description: Join the penguin’s adventure in Penguin Adventure! You will play as a penguin who must reach the castle in each level. You will explore three worlds, each with its own challenges and surprises. You will also have to control the penguin’s actions. You will collect stars and hearts along the way, which will affect your score and rewards. You will need enough yellow stars to unlock the next world. Penguin Adventure is a game that will test your reaction and strategy. Don’t miss this fun game!

title: Train Drift
description: Train Drifting is an addictive arcade racing game that offers players a unique and incredible train drifting experience. In this game you will become a real master of drifting on iron horses.

title: Solitaire L'Amour
description: Love is in the air. And so is Solitaire! Enter an enchanting world as you fall head over heels for this charming new Solitaire adventure!

title: Gloomy Princess Favorite Toy
description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious world of the Gloomy Princess and her strange but touching teddy friend. Create unique images for the heroine of the game: choose makeup, outfits and accessories - from witch hats to lace corsets in the Gothic spirit. Add personality to her favorite toy. Assemble the perfect duo - a princess hiding her feelings behind a flawless image, and her beloved companion reflecting the inner world of the hostess!

title: Fruit King Merge
description: Fruit King Merge is a bright and addictive arcade game where your goal is to merge identical fruits to create new, larger, and more valuable ones. As you play, you will earn coins, unlock new types of fruit, and aim for the highest possible score. Colorful graphics, smooth animations, and simple controls make the game suitable for all ages and perfect for engaging gaming sessions.

title: I Am Security
description: Have you ever wanted to be a hardened security officer and be on the front lines of maintaining order? In I Am Security, an ultra-realistic role-playing simulator, you play the role of a professional security guard. You decide whether or not to allow them to enter. Some guests may try to sneak in with prohibited items and find these hidden items. Performs tasks in a variety of scenarios to identify suspicious persons.

title: Crocodilo Tralalero Run
description: Crocodilo Tralalero Run is a fast-paced platformer where your Crazy fiends runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Unlock and customize your Crazy fiends in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Crocodilo, Tralalero, Tsung Tsung and others characters offers fun for all ages!

title: Little Dentist Dash
description: Little Dental Dash is a charming clinic management where you step into the role of a friendly dentist helping kids with their dental problems. From fixing chipped teeth to carefully placing braces, each patient brings a new challenge that tests your speed and attention to detail. Treat your young patients, keep them smiling, and earn rewards for your excellent work.

title: Wire Connect
description:
Captivating puzzle game where your task is to connect electrical devices to power outlets by drawing conductive paths. But be careful — electricity will flow along your lines, and if it touches water or bystanders, it will cause a short circuit!

Your goal is to find a safe route, avoid all hazards, and complete the level successfully.
Each new puzzle demands focus, logic, and precision. As you progress, the challenges become more complex, with more obstacles, devices, and tricky scenarios.

title: Deadlock.io
description: Deadlock.io is an exciting game in the deadlock setting, where you capture territories and avoid enemies. Compete for the territory in thrilling battles! Become the leader of the arena like in paper.io!

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: Gomu Goman
description: With simple tap-and-drag gameplay, Gomu Goman offers hundreds of challenging and laugh-out-loud levels. Each level is a unique puzzle that demands creativity—and a certain degree of spicy humor from you.

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

title: 2048 Puzzle: Connect the Balls
Urus City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports SUV through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Adversator
description: Adversator is an amazing 3D game that has MOBA elements. This is a multiplayer battle that pits you against different foes – you must choose from one of several different heroes to fight with.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Minicraft Winterblock
description: Winter has arrived, and everything is covered in snow. In the snow-covered forest, you must be very careful to survive. You need to find two chests and collect all the snowballs. But be cautious, there are monsters everywhere waiting to eat you. You must defeat the monsters and reach the hidden portal at the end of the level. You must leave the house safely and pass through the portal.

title: Hidden Object Farm Adventure
description: Play a fun hidden object game with 30 farm levels! each level, find 6 hidden things before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint! It's easy to play and full of colorful farm fun.

title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
description:
Break bricks, collect power-ups for more fun breaking bricks and watch Chipy Chipy Chipa Cat and El Primo Bara Bere dancing. Go through interesting and exciting levels in the fun game about Chippy Chippy Chippy Chappa Chappa Cat and El Primo.
Pass levels of different difficulty and set a personal record.

title: Delivery Now
description:
Delivery Now is an open world endless delivery game , which uses spectacular graphics and amazing audio effects to give a breathtaking game play experience.

Delivery Now is a fast paced action and racing game in which you will have to race against time to deliver these cute things, making your way through city highway traffic racers. You can make your own path towards your goal.

Let's enjoy it. What are you waiting for?

title: Brother!Follow Me! - Merge Men
description:
It's a 3D running game where you control a runner as you navigate various obstacles, overcome challenges, and face off against a boss at the end of each level. This action-packed game combines exciting competitions, battles, and intense conflicts.

Collect and lead your brothers along the way, and grow your team to challenge the final game.

title: Food Merge
description: ​Food Merge is a game where you combine different foods to create delicious dishes and serve them to hungry customers. Merge ingredients quickly and strategically to before the time runs out! Each level brings new challenges, faster orders, and more complex combos. Can you keep up and become the ultimate food master?

title: College Girl Coloring Dress Up
description:
BFF high school fashion makeover: coloring book & cool dress up games for girls!
New college girls dress up game & coloring book is here for you! Dress up the most popular high school girls, create their whole look, paint and color. These cool coloring pages and clothes design features made especially for fashion girls. Begin total fashion makeover with our girl dress up games!

Design outfits like a fashionista: dress up, choose hairstyle, necklaces and other amazing accessories such as skirts and dresses. Select a color and click on the fragment you want to color, when the painting of college girl is created, start drawing and coloring, become BFF fashion clothes designer.

Take screenshots, save as wallpaper, and share cute coloring pages with your friends and family absolutely for free.

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: Kaboom Miner
description:
A fast-paced logical arcade inspired by classic Boulder Dash, but taken to the next level with massive chain explosions.
Your goal is simple—but dangerous: destroy all 50 explosive crates. Use falling stones, carefully placed bombs, and clever terrain manipulation to trigger devastating chain reactions. Every move matters. Push stones, move crates, build bridges from bricks, and even trap the Ghost before finishing it off.

title: Merge Car Defense
description:
Prepare to battle wave upon wave of relentless enemies as you skilfully merge and upgrade the defences of your cars.

Build out a roster of cars and use them tactically in order to defeat the enemy, collect coins and be victorious!

title: Jewel Garden Story
description: Enter a dazzling realm where sparkling jewels await your matching skills. Challenge yourself to achieve high scores and enjoy the visually stunning jewel combinations. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless entertainment.

title: Squid Escape Game
description: You must escape from this iron-covered labyrinth prison. Both blue players need to escape the prison. You must collect all the geometric shapes. Collect all the shapes and find both keys. Find the keys and run to the door. Be very careful, there are thorny obstacles on the ground. Don't stray too far from your friend; if you lose each other, you will lose the game.

title: Get To The Chopper
description: Gear up and fight your way to safety in Get To The Chopper, a thrilling 3D first-person shooter where every mission is a battle for survival! Your objective is clear: reach the extraction chopper while eliminating all enemies standing in your way. Armed with a fully customizable loadout—including a primary gun, secondary weapon, grenades, and a melee weapon—you’ll face waves of enemies across dynamic battlefields such as forests, deserts, and more.

title: Dye It Right: Color Picker
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Dye It Right: Color Picker, where creativity meets fun! In this casual puzzle game, you’ll begin a colorful journey. This game is filled with exciting challenges designed for kids and the young at heart.

title: 2248 Blast
description: Are you ready to train your brain while having fun? 2248 Blast is a highly addictive number-connecting puzzle game designed to relax your mind and sharpen your logic skills! With simple swipe controls and engaging gameplay, this game is perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages.

title: Gang War: Strike Shooter
description:
Welcome to a fast-paced multiplayer shooter! Break out of prison and dive straight into a brutal gang war. Join the Reds or the Blues, capture banks, warehouses, factories, and other city locations. Each captured zone earns you income — spend it on new weapons and character customization!

Play with friends, compete for dominance, and survive the dangerous streets. Only strength, strategy, and loyal teammates matter here. An open world full of conflict, shootouts, and endless possibilities.

title: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2
description: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a famous snake-hunting game when Sprunki head and Squid head as main avatar character in this game. You become a small snake that runs endlessly and continuously moves to eat the food, each time it eats it will become longer. Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a simple game that became an instant success soon after its launch.

title: Fruit Catcher
description:
Catch as many fruits as you can before they fall! ?
Move your basket left and right to collect fresh fruits and avoid rotten ones. Each fruit gives you points — how high can your score go?
This fun and colorful game tests your reflexes and speed. Perfect for kids and casual players who love simple but addictive gameplay!

title: Hook Master Mafia City
description:
Hook Master: Mafia City is a casual puzzle game that combines puzzle solving, escape and collecting elements. In this dangerous city, you have to solve puzzles with your smart mind and use a cool grappling hook and swing skills, like a secret agent's flexible dodge, precise strike
and successfully escape the enemy hunt! There are two kinds of gameplay: grappling and swinging. Use the grapple for flexible movement, quickly across the city by snagging walls, buildings and so on.

title: Spot&Differs
description: A new exciting game "Spot&Differs" for children and adults! Find differences between two pictures and train your brain and mindfulness. If you like to play logic games, join us!

title: Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills
description:
Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills is a tense survival horror where you roam a fog-covered forest to steal brainrot pages while being hunted by the relentless Sahur entity.
No weapons, no escape-only rising whispers, shifting woods, and the race to survive before the echoes of “TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR” close in.

title: Crazy Hill Climbing
description:
Get ready for the ultimate hill racing adventure in Crazy Hill Climbing! Race through steep hills, rugged terrains, and tackle challenging obstacles. With 15 unique levels and cars to unlock, upgrade your vehicles and customize your rides as you strive to conquer each track and perform daring stunts.

* Use coins to upgrade your engine, tires, suspension, and more to improve performance on rough terrains
* Execute daring front flips and back flips to earn extra points and boost your score

title: Woolloop! Color Puzzle
description: Knit Color Flow is a cozy yarn game where soft wool, gentle motion, and colorful puzzles blend into a peaceful experience. Watch the bobbins glide across conveyor belts as patterns slowly take shape, creating a world full of balance and visual harmony. The calm atmosphere, smooth animations, and comforting design invite you to relax while enjoying a steady sense of flow from the very first level.

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Granny: Halloween House
description:
Granny Horror Escape is a scary escape room game on yad.com. Grandma has locked you in her big house and
  your goal is to escape from this house. Grandma's house is very big with many rooms and finding an
  exit is not a simple task. Good luck!

title: Sprunki 3D Shooter
description: Sprunki 3D Shooter delivers nonstop action as you face off against waves of Sprunkies! Your mission is simple: shoot to survive as long as you can. Run out of ammo? Search the battlefield for scattered rounds to keep the fight alive. Gear up and prepare to take on the Sprunkies—can you last the challenge?

title: Zombie Chase
description: In Zombie Chase, players navigate a chaotic world filled with the undead, using every ounce of strategic prowess to outlast the apocalypse. This is not a typical racing game, youll need to manage resources and make smart decisions to survive the relentless zombie hordes. Your brain isnt just a desirable snack for zombies in this game - its your greatest weapon!

title: Zombie Arena 2 Fury Road
description:
The player assumes the role of a driver in Zombie Arena 2 Fury Road, whose objective is to navigate a confined arena populated by zombies while using their vehicle as a weapon to overcome waves of the undead and unlock new levels.

Also, there are modes where you have to beat the clock or fend off waves of zombies, respectively, and games where you have to live as long as possible.

title: Hexa Block: Honey Cells
description: Dive into the exciting world of logic and shapes. Your task is to fill the field with multi-colored hexagonal blocks, choosing the right combinations. Each level is a new puzzle that requires attention, logic and precise calculation. Exciting gameplay, smooth animation and bright graphics make the gameplay as enjoyable as possible.

title: Steal Brainrot Duel
description: Steal Brainrot Duel is a fast, competitive collector-raider where you hunt for the best brainrot characters, defend your base from thieves, and outsmart rivals in Solo or 2 Player mode. Start with simple picks like Noobini Pizzanini, then grind your economy to unlock rare and legendary favorites such as Tralalero Tralala, Cocofanto Elefanto, and Graipussi Medussi. Build income, raid others, protect your stash, and style your obby avatar with hats, glasses, backpacks, wings, outfits, and pets!

title: Diner in the Storm
description: Diner in the Storm is a puzzle adventure game that plunges you into a heart-pounding escape adventure, where danger lurks not only outside but within the walls of a seemingly ordinary roadside diner. Caught in the grip of a sudden and ominous storm, you seek shelter in a roadside diner, only to find that safety is fleeting, and the diner harbors dark secrets.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Perfect Tidy
description: Welcome to Perfect Tidy, a simple and relaxing cleaning simulator game that you can play for free. Are you good at cleaning work? Searching for something that is stress-relieving? Join Perfect Tidy, where you can dive into multiple cleaning tasks: Car washing, skin care, teeth fixing, pet care, and more. Unlike cleaning in real life, all you have to do in the game is click, drag, and enjoy the present moment.

title: The Drag Racing Challenge
description: Welcome to The Drag Racing Challenge game, an exciting new arcade racing game! Race through challenging missions, unlock and upgrade over 12 cars, and compete against opponents with customizable vehicles. Test your skills in realistic maps across five cities and enjoy smooth, high-quality racing. No fuel or time limits—just endless drag racing fun!

title: Elemental Gloves Magic Power
description: Elemental Gloves - Magic Power is a superpower arcade game.  Experience the fun of superpowers in magic games? Fascinated by elemental games? In this game, you can use the superpowers in the magic gloves to fight with your enemies. Shooting with flames, attacking with lightning, and attacking with electromagnetic waves, are three ways for you to choose. Don't hesitate to take the opportunity to practice real elemental magic and wipe out the bad guys. Become the greatest elemental master!

title: Space.io
description: Jump into the cockpit of a powerful spaceship and engage in fast-paced 3D space battles! Face off against 9 other enemy ships in an intense dogfight where only the best pilot survives. Shoot down your opponents before they take you out, climb the rankings, and prove you're the ultimate space warrior! Unlock a wide variety of skins to customize your ship and dominate the battlefield in style. Can you claim the top spot?

title: Spider Solitaire 2 Suits
description: Spider Solitaire 2 Suits is a challenging Solitaire game limited to two suits and two decks of cards. Move the cards around the tableau so they are in order by suit and number.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fish Story 3
description: Welcome to Fish Story 3! Immerse yourself in 4,000+ levels of Match 3 excitement guided by our mermaid host. Solve puzzles, conquer Daily Missions, and unlock treasures in the Daily Challenge. Dive into addictive challenges and return daily for rewards. Join the underwater adventure now!

title: Ocean Pop
description: Ocean Pop is a lively underwater puzzle game where real 2D bubbles float, bounce, and cluster with natural physics. Pop matching bubbles, trigger chain reactions, and enjoy dynamic, ever-shifting puzzles. Its colorful ocean setting, smooth mechanics, and playful movement create a relaxing yet engaging experience that’s easy to learn and satisfying to master.

Winter Tetrix Trails is a relaxing shape-filling puzzle game set in a snowy world.
Drag and place colorful Tetris-style blocks to complete each unique silhouette — think carefully, fit perfectly, and enjoy the magic of winter puzzles!

Rediscover the classic game of Tic-Tac-Toe (XO) like never before with "Tic Tac Toe: Match Three"! description:
Make precise jumps while avoiding certain death. Guide a brave ninja to his goal as he overcomes his deadly obstacles. Over 30 levels filled with fun and challenge. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Mk48.io
description: Mk48.io is an Io battleship game that thrusts you into the heart of intense multiplayer naval warfare, where only the fiercest captains have what it takes to dominate the seas. Command your vessel and level up by collecting valuable crates and sinking enemy ships, gaining power and upgrades as you rise.

description: Embark on a temple adventure in Bubble Shooter Temple Jewels! Pop colorful bubbles as you progress through ancient ruins inspired by Central American temples. Keep track of your journey with the Stats screen, showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With vibrant visuals, exciting challenges, and detailed progress tracking, this bubble shooter keeps you motivated to aim higher and improve every round!

Drop magical elixirs, merge matching colors, and evolve them into powerful rainbow potions! 
A relaxing physics puzzle game inspired by merge mechanics and alchemy.
Plan your drops carefully and create the ultimate elixir.

description: Assemble the dream room and show your friends how to transform the space with clever combos! Join Match-3: Dream Room and create your dream room by solving puzzles and enjoying the exciting process of furnishing!

description: The aim of the Bus Collect game is to collect the passengers waiting on the road by making the right directions and deliver them to the finish point. To do this, direct the roads the vehicle will follow with arrow signs. Try to reach high scores by carrying as many passengers as possible to the finish point.

description: Make your way through the streets in this endless runner game while you encounter various challenges. In the level mode its your goal to reach the grocery store without losing. In the endless mode your goal is to reach as far as possible without losing.

description: Bounce into blissful heights with Happy Jump! Guide the cute chicken on its springy pogo to leap skyward amid lush trees and fun obstacles. Smash your personal best, snag stars, and chase trophies in this addictive, one-tap thrill. Endless jumps, soaring scores—pure joy awaits!

title: Robot Runner Fight
description: Are you ready for a robotic parkour adventure? Robots run and fight on high-speed parkour platforms!  Youll control a flexible robot that travels through the city of the future. Avoid obstacles, fight enemies, and race to the finish line.

description:
Metal Bay Top Blade Power is a top-down action game inspired by spinning blade battles.

Control a powerful metal top blade and fight against enemies in the Metal Bay arena, using real-time physics-based collisions and spin power mechanics.

Master speed, impact force, and rotation control to understand when to attack, collide, or evade.

description: Welcome to Celebrity Spring Fashion Trends. Hello little girls. Are you ready for the latest spring fashion collection? title: ARROW OUT AND LINKER
description:
ARROW OUT AND LINKER is a smart, direction-based puzzle game where every move counts. Your mission is to guide the arrow through intricate mazes and lead it to the exit.

Rotate tiles, shift paths, and think several steps ahead to build the perfect route. Each decision shapes the outcome, rewarding careful planning and shap logic.

title: Lunar Phase Battle
description: Play Lunar Phase Battle, a simple turn-based strategy game! Connect moon phases to claim tiles and score points. Both players can take each other's tiles by creating pairs or cycles. Each captured tile adds to your score. Dive into celestial strategy and compete to outsmart your opponent!

title: Run Now
description: Dive into Run Now, where each step is a puzzle waiting to be solved! This game offers a unique blend of creative challenges, quirky humor, and addictive gameplay. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike, Run Now invites you to test your skills in a world filled with unexpected obstacles and entertaining surprises.

title: Brawl Stars Battle
description: Brawl Stars Battle is an exciting action shooting game where you control powerful heroes armed with guns and special abilities to defeat opponents in fast-paced combat! Select 3v3 battle mode and fight alongside your teammates. The team that kills fifteen opponents first wins. Use guns and powerful abilities in intense battles.

title: Zombie Survival Shooter
description: Ready for an all-out apocalypse escape? Zombie Survival Shooter throws you straight into a world overrun by zombies. Zombies attack from every direction. Keep moving, dodge smartly, and never stop running. Shoot the digital doors to gain more helpers or boost your attack speed, etc. Use your strategy to choose which digital door to go through.

title: Marble Bubble Legend
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Bubble Shooter Remastered
description: Shoot groups of bubbles and form groups to make them pop. Form groups of 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make the bubbles explode.

From E-girl and Soft-girl vibes to edgy streetwear and glam red carpet ensembles, showcase your creativity and win the ultimate fashion battle. Can you rise to the challenge and become the trendsetting fashion icon? Let the style showdown begin!

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes
